youtube_description:
Hey everyone, welcome to this video where we're going to fix the Epson 034004 error. If you're like me, you've probably encountered this error and have tried turning off the printer and turning it back on, only to have the problem return. Well, the good news is that this error is caused by a paper jam, and we're going to show you how to fix it. Even if you don't see a paper jam, that doesn't mean there isn't one. So, let's get started and get your printer back up and running in no time.

We fixed a persistent Epson Printer Error  034004 (Error code E-01) - Contact Epson Support. Non-printing features are available.  The problem was caused by a paper jam which we couldn't figure out by simply removing all the papers.  This error also occurs in Epson L220 and Epson L210, and maybe an Epson l380 red light blinking problem solution.
